correctness.rationale: The dense parameterization is the toric monomial map (u,v,w)↦(u_iv_j,u_iw,v_jw), which is an immersion up to common scaling. Pulling a hyperplane back gives homogeneous quadratic u^TMv+wα^Tu+wβ^Tv. Its tangency gradient is (Mv+wα,M^Tu+wβ,α^Tu+β^Tv)=0. For generic full-row-rank M and w=1, this is precisely β=M^Tλ and λ^Tα=0, equivalent to rank≤a of T=[M α;β^T 0]; generic solutions with all torus coordinates nonzero exist. The rank≤a locus inside southeast-zero hyperplane is irreducible because each matrix factors PQ with rank factor a and constraint (PQ)_{last,last}=sum_{i=1}^a P_{last,i} Q_{i,last}=0, an irreducible polynomial for a≥2, so its generic tangencies are dense. Its open affine dimension ab+2a−1 in coefficient ambient ab+a+b gives codim b−a+1. The generic maximal-minor determinantal degree binomial(b+1,a) is unchanged by a proper non-contained projective hyperplane section. The Mv=−α solution affine fiber of dimension b−a maps linearly to contact closure P^(b−a); a=b yields adjugate determinant. Direct symbolic balanced a=b=2 and rectangular a=2,b=3 cases independently checked torus tangency, augmented rank, and adjugate identity. General proof independent of these small checks.
